title: SuperMe, which generates AI-powered chats with simulated profiles of prominent industry experts to let users ask questions, raised $20M (Ivan Mehta/TechCrunch)
summary: Ivan Mehta / TechCrunch: SuperMe, which generates AI-powered chats with simulated profiles of prominent industry experts to let users ask questions, raised $20M — When people have career or job questions, they usually tap into their network to find experts who've faced a similar predicament and can offer answers.
